model_version: claude-opus-5-5 (the pinned runtime reports no finer version; init and modelUsage must name exactly this ID)
reasoning: default (no effort flag) in both arms

tool_differences.git: Two writable Git worktrees with native Read/Grep/Glob/Edit/Write and unsandboxed-by-Claude Bash inside the host sandbox-exec profile; host commands (message/share/ack/check/ready) via Bash; unfinished diffs; ordinary merges and conflict resolution; exact host-captured checks. The worker sandbox allows outbound network for the runtime, so Git-arm Bash also has network; Falinks-arm Bash runs in Claude Code's sandbox without it. No Falinks ledger or offer/reconsideration protocol.
tool_differences.falinks: Live group workspace read with native Read/Grep/Glob; source changes only through engine-mediated falinks tools (edits, revision-bound reviews, offers, feedback runs, regrouping, gofmt job) plus host ack/check/ready tools. Claude Code's own sandbox: Bash writes only scratch. Enrollment fixes the file set: fixture files except dot-paths (held by the host and added to every candidate) plus x_test.go / tests/x.rs per source file. Publication requires the engine's visible checks; host check/final readiness add the oracle.
tool_differences.shared: Same pinned Claude Code binary, model, default reasoning, --max-turns 12 per message with host continuation, isolation flags, fresh sessions, allocation, requirements, dependency information, milestone triggers, peer-event delivery at presentation boundaries, two-minute idle reminders, pass/fail-only visible+oracle checks and 30-minute bound. No oracle/reference access.

runtime_binary: REQUIRED: absolute dedicated copy of the pinned claude 2.1.287
denied_roots: REQUIRED: checkout, other runs and any reference copies
runtime_home: REQUIRED: home holding the subscription login (normally $HOME)
evaluation_root: REQUIRED: absolute path of this evaluation directory
